verdict.rationale: Neon supports natural-language operation through its hosted MCP Server (113 tools, scoped/read-only modes, verified live via probes) that lets AI agents/clients query and manage databases in natural language, plus the CLI's `neon ask` natural-language assistant and SQL Editor's AI query generation. Coverage spans multiple official surfaces (MCP, CLI ask, SQL editor AI) with runtime probe corroboration. missing for 10: no independent/community hands-on evidence of end-to-end natural-language task completion (only vendor docs and probes), and some features (AI Gateway, MCP hosted server) are explicitly beta/deprecated in places.
